name: University of Iowa Secondary Student Training Program (SSTP), Summer 2027
what_you_do: Join a University of Iowa faculty member's research group. Work on a research project. If you finish, you earn 3 semester hours of college credit.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 10 and 11. The page describes it as a program for advanced high school students.
pay_detail: The page lists a $7,500 program fee with no year beside it (room, board, materials, activities and 3 credit hours). Travel and personal costs are extra. Financial aid may cover up to 95 percent. There is a $95 application fee that is not refunded.
deadline_text: Opens Dec 15, 2026 at 5:00 pm CST. Closes Feb 16, 2027 at 11:59 pm CST. Session June 16 to July 23, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Fill in your information and pay the $95 fee. Get two letters from non-relative adults (one academic, one character). Write two essays of up to 750 words. Upload your transcript and SAT or ACT scores. Questions: summer@belinblank.org.
notes: Confirm the 2027 cost with summer@belinblank.org: the page shows the $7,500 fee with no year beside it.
